info.title: Agency Tracking API
info.description: Labor-recruitment/placement platform (Ethiopia -> Saudi Arabia / Kuwait corridors) API surface. Every endpoint is a whitelisted Frappe method under /api/method/agency_tracking.*, mediated by its own explicit permission check -- there is no raw /api/resource/* access to any doctype in this app (see agency_tracking/CLAUDE.md Part F). Roles referenced under x-roles on each operation are the custom roles defined in agency_tracking/roles.py; see the full list below.

sessionCookie.name: Cookie
sessionCookie.description: Session-cookie auth for everyone (staff and agencies), per Part F: 'Auth: session-cookie for everyone.' Obtained via POST /api/method/login.

csrfToken.name: X-Frappe-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: Required on every state-changing (POST) request once logged in. Fetch via agency_tracking.auth_api.get_csrf_token.

post.summary: Log in (raw Frappe endpoint)
post.description: Standard Frappe session-cookie login. Not an agency_tracking function -- Frappe's own built-in auth endpoint, listed here because it's the first call any frontend makes.

post.summary: Log out
post.description: Ends the current session cookie.

post.summary: Get current session user
post.description: allow_guest=True so a page refresh doesn't 403 before the SPA even knows whether a session exists. Returns null for Guest, otherwise user/full_name/roles.
x-roles: Guest (anyone) -- returns null if not logged in

post.summary: Get CSRF token
post.description: Frappe requires this token on every state-changing request once logged in.

get.description: Returns this full Swagger 2.0 / OpenAPI specification as a JSON object.

post.summary: Upload a file (raw Frappe endpoint)
post.description: Standard Frappe multipart file upload -- returns a file_url that most agency_tracking parsing endpoints (parse_contract_file, parse_passport_file, upload_contract, etc.) expect as their file_url argument.
x-roles: Any authenticated user with write access to the target doctype

parameters.name: is_private
parameters.description: 1 = private (default for most agency_tracking uploads), 0 = public

parameters.name: doctype
parameters.description: Doctype to attach to, e.g. 'Applicant Transaction'

post.summary: Cancel an Applicant (global escape hatch)
post.description: Only from Registered/CV Generated. If an active_placement exists, freezes it and every linked Clearance Step to Cancelled first, then cancels the Applicant itself. Never bumps cycle_number by itself -- only a later restart does.

post.summary: Open a new Applicant file at Draft
post.description: Draft floor: full_name, gender, nationality, entry_track. Accepts any other Applicant field as additional form data.

post.summary: Fetch a single Applicant
post.description: Full doc as dict.

post.summary: List Applicants the caller's role can read
post.description: backend-issues #02: whitelisted replacement for the raw /api/resource/Applicant fallback. Enforces the doctype's own permissions (Registrar, Manager, Admin, System Manager, Finance Manager, Clearance Officer, Complaint Manager, Communication Manager, and the six country+step roles).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: JSON-encoded dict or list of Frappe filter conditions.

post.summary: Set a permanent per-(Applicant, Country) ban
post.description: backend-issues #08: previously no whitelisted writer existed for Applicant Country Ban -- the doctype's own permissions already grant create to Registrar/Complaint Manager/Manager/Admin/System Manager.

post.summary: List country bans, optionally scoped to one Applicant
Lift a country ban
post.description: Delete permission on Applicant Country Ban is Manager/Admin/System Manager only -- Registrar/Complaint Manager can set a ban but not lift one.

post.summary: Manually log the Registration Fee to the Finance ledger
post.description: Sets fee_status=Paid and saves -- Applicant.maybe_log_fee_transaction then creates the actual Pending Applicant Transaction in the same save. Requires fee_required + registration_fee_amount already set; throws if this fee was already logged.
x-roles: Any internal staff role (Registrar, Clearance Officer, Ticketer, Finance Manager, Manager, Admin, etc.)

post.summary: Draft -> Registered
post.description: Field-floor and medical checks run inside Applicant.validate(), triggered by the sanctioned transition() path.

post.summary: Restart a Cancelled Applicant
post.description: Cancelled -> Draft or Registered. cycle_number bumps automatically. Restarting straight to Registered fails naturally if the field floor isn't actually satisfied.

post.summary: Edit an Applicant at Draft or Registered
post.description: Does not change status -- use register_applicant for that. If entry_track changes while Registered/CV Generated, forces a regression to Draft first (cycle_number bumps automatically). destination_country changes are checked against Applicant Country Ban.

parameters.name: override_ban
parameters.description: Manager/Admin only, to push past a country ban

post.summary: LMIS-stage edit: national_id, labor_id, emergency contact, COC
post.description: Narrow allowlisted edit surface -- national_id/labor_id/emergency_contact_*/coc_status/exam_date are deliberately NOT part of the Registered field floor; they're captured here once the candidate is actually at the LMIS clearance step. Any field outside the allowlist is silently ignored.

post.summary: List which officer is currently assigned to each Clearance Step on a Placement
post.description: Sourced from the same open ToDo assignment data that drives Clearance Step permissions -- every Placement detail view exposes who's currently working each step.

post.summary: Add a participant to an internal thread
post.description: Agency threads are fixed at exactly two participants -- blocked outright for those.

post.summary: Create/get this agency's thread with the Communication Manager
post.description: Foreign Agency only. No recipient parameter -- routing happens entirely server-side.

post.summary: Create/get an internal staff-to-staff thread
post.description: Internal staff only, open between all staff, no role restriction. Never a route into an agency's thread.

post.summary: Get all messages in a thread
List the current user's threads
x-roles: Any authenticated user (results scoped to their own threads)

post.summary: Mark a thread as read for the current user
Send a message in a thread
post.description: Must have text or an attachment. Mentioning an Applicant/Placement still requires read permission on the mentioned record.

post.summary: Mark a Clearance Step complete/Issued
post.description: Not for Embassy steps. LMIS (both countries) completes to 'Issued'; everything else (Taeshir, Telesign) completes to the generic 'Complete'. Blocked (417) once the step is already terminal (Issued/Complete/Stamped/Rejected) or its parent Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-3).
x-roles: Anyone holding the role mapped to this step_type (Saudi LMIS, Saudi Taeshir, Kuwait LMIS, Kuwait Telesign)

post.summary: List the current user's Clearance Step queue
post.description: A Clearance Officer/Ticketer's own ToDo-scoped queue, or -- for the six country+step roles -- every row of their matching step_type.
x-roles: Any authenticated staff user (results scoped by role)

post.summary: Reassign a Clearance Step to a different officer
post.description: The escape hatch for the default auto-chain assignment. Blocked (417) once the step is already terminal (Issued/Complete/Stamped/Rejected) or its parent Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-3).

post.summary: Mark an Embassy step Rejected (Thursday, failure outcome)
post.description: Saudi/Kuwait Embassy only. A written rejection_remark is required. Blocked (417) once the step is already terminal (Issued/Complete/Stamped/Rejected) or its parent Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-3).

post.summary: Mark an Embassy step Stamped (Thursday, success outcome)
post.description: Saudi/Kuwait Embassy only. Blocked (417) once the step is already terminal (Issued/Complete/Stamped/Rejected) or its parent Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-3).

post.summary: Mark a Clearance Step In Progress
post.description: Blocked (417) once the step is already terminal (Issued/Complete/Stamped/Rejected) or its parent Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-3).
x-roles: Anyone holding the mapped country+step role

post.summary: Submit an Embassy step's documents (Monday)
post.description: Saudi/Kuwait Embassy only. Pending -> Submitted. Blocked (417) once the step is already terminal (Issued/Complete/Stamped/Rejected) or its parent Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-3).

post.summary: New -> Unresolved
Log a complaint against a placed worker
post.description: A Foreign Agency can only complain about their own placement; internal staff need a recognized staff role.

post.summary: List Unresolved complaints, oldest-first
post.description: So nothing quietly sits forgotten at the bottom of a list.

post.summary: Resolve a complaint (Resolved / Free Replacement / Escalated / Dismissed)
post.description: Dismissed requires a written resolution_notes. override_reason (Manager Override) widens permission to include plain Manager for that one call.

post.summary: Extract structured fields from an uploaded contract
post.description: Saudi: contract#/visa#/employer/agency/salary. Kuwait: employer/site/duration/salary only (its template carries far less). Returns mock fixture data instead of real OCR when Document Parsing Settings.use_mock_parsing is on.
x-roles: Any authenticated user (called internally by placement_api.upload_contract, not typically called directly)

post.summary: Extract fields from a Saudi Injaz paper
post.description: Injaz application number, passport number, applicant demographics, origin agency.

post.summary: Extract fields from a Kuwait eVisa document
post.description: visa_number/type/dates/reference, sponsor name+civil ID, Kuwait agency name+license.

post.summary: Get the ordered step definitions for a destination country's corridor
post.description: Data-driven -- adding a new corridor (e.g. a third country) is purely a Corridor Definition doc, no code change.

post.summary: Generate and attach the official Agency CV PDF
post.description: Standard track, Registered status only. Renders via a Frappe Print Format, mirrors to Cloudflare R2 (falls back to a local private file if Storage Settings isn't configured). Moves the Applicant to CV Generated.

post.summary: Approve a Pending transaction
post.description: Pending -> Approved via the sanctioned transition() path. Only Approved entries count toward ledger/balance totals.

post.summary: Batch a contractor's owed commissions for settlement

parameters.name: transaction_names
parameters.description: JSON array of specific transaction names; omit to batch everything owed

parameters.name: requested_advance_amount
parameters.description: Up-front ASAP ask recorded on the batch (Birr), separate from advance received

post.summary: Get the cached FX rate for a currency
post.description: ETB is hardcoded to 1.0 (Birr itself, no conversion needed). Other currencies fall back to the most recent cached rate on or before as_of_date; throws if none was ever recorded.

post.summary: List a contractor's owed (unbatched, Approved) commissions
Log an expense
post.description: Open to any internal staff role -- Finance Manager/Admin approval (approve_transaction) is the real gate, not who's allowed to log. placement is optional (general office expenses are loggable too).

post.summary: Log income
post.description: Same shape/permissions as log_stage_expense.

post.summary: Reject a Pending transaction
post.description: Pending -> Rejected. A written rejection_reason is required.

post.summary: Manually record an FX rate
post.description: Custom-mode path (FX Rate Settings). ETB cannot be set -- it's always 1:1, hardcoded.

fx_rate.description: The new FX Rate record's name (a hash), NOT the rate value -- call get_fx_rate to read the value back.

post.summary: Mark specific Commission Batch Items paid (partial settlement)
post.description: AGREED_SPEC.md Part 7.3 (backend-issues #09): explicit multi-select manual settlement, alongside upload_batch_payment_proof's parser. Batch status becomes Partially Settled until every item is Paid.

parameters.name: item_names
parameters.description: JSON-encoded list of Commission Batch Item child row names.

post.summary: Upload a paid-applicants list (CSV or PDF) and fuzzy-match against a batch
post.description: AGREED_SPEC.md Part 7.3 (backend-issues #09): best-effort parse + fuzzy name match against the batch's own item list. Unmatched names stay Pending for manual settle_batch_items review -- never blocks.

post.summary: Render a Commission Batch invoice PDF on demand
post.description: AGREED_SPEC.md Part 7.3 (backend-issues #09): applicant names + amounts, built fresh whenever requested, not pre-generated/stored at batch creation.

post.summary: Mark a Commission Batch settled
Manually trigger commission accrual early
post.description: For cases needing to bill sooner than Departed. Idempotency-guarded -- calling this then later reaching Departed naturally is a no-op the second time.

post.summary: Void an Approved transaction
post.description: Approved -> Voided, via transition(). No hard delete, ever -- the row stays visible with its status flagged. A written void_reason is required.

post.summary: Check whether the current user has an active Push Subscription
post.description: Drives the manual 'enable notifications' fallback button.

post.summary: Subscribe the current browser to Push notifications
post.description: A user subscribing their own browser -- never on behalf of anyone else.

post.summary: Manually trigger a Wakala payment reminder
post.description: The escape hatch alongside the automatic Fri/Sat/Sun watchdog. Embassy steps only.
x-roles: Read access to the Clearance Step

post.summary: Extract MRZ fields from a passport scan
post.description: ICAO 9303 checksum self-correcting MRZ parser (TD3/TD1), falls back to visual OCR. Never raises -- returns {} on failure.

post.summary: Register a new foreign agency and its portal login
post.description: backend-issues #07: Contractor.user is a required, unique Link, so there was previously no whitelisted way to create one -- Muayena placement creation (create_muayena_placement's contractor_name) is unusable without a Contractor to point at.

post.summary: List Contractors the caller's role can manage
post.description: backend-issues #07: read surface for picking an existing agency (create_muayena_placement's contractor_name, Finance's batching/rate lookups).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: JSON-encoded dict or list of Frappe filter conditions.

post.summary: Move a Placement forward via the sanctioned transition() path
post.description: The direct/manual advance. override_reason attempts a Manager Override if the move is gate-blocked.

post.summary: Create a Placement directly (Muayena track)
post.description: Muayena enters directly at Selected with contract in hand -- no portal, no CV. Contractor is always picked manually.

parameters.name: file_url
parameters.description: Optional signed contract to parse immediately

post.summary: Record a ticket reschedule
post.description: reschedule_cost only meaningful/loggable when cause=Internal -- an airline/airport-caused reschedule isn't billed to the agency. Blocked (417) once the Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-1).

post.summary: Record the post-contract medical result
post.description: Gates Selected -> Processing. FIT just records the result; UNFIT cancels the whole Applicant + Placement via the same cascade as cancel_applicant. Blocked (417) once the Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-1).

post.summary: Record the pre-departure (Medical 2) result
post.description: Gates Ticketed -> Departed. FIT just records the result; UNFIT cancels the whole Applicant + Placement via the same cascade as cancel_applicant. Blocked (417) once the Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-1).

post.summary: Record ticket number/flight date, auto-logs cost as an expense
post.description: ticket_cost (if given) auto-creates a Pending Applicant Transaction expense. Blocked (417) once the Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-1).

message.description: May include an extra 'warning' string property if cost-logging failed (see 04-finance-contract.md).

post.summary: Attach a signed contract to a Selected Placement
post.description: Extracts contract_signed_date plus country-specific structured fields via contract_parser.parse_contract_file.
x-roles: The Contractor who made the selection

post.summary: Attach a Kuwait visa document
post.description: Kuwait only. Cross-checks the parsed agency identity against the Placement's actual Contractor and flags a mismatch (notify, never auto-reassigns).
x-roles: The Contractor who made the selection

post.summary: List Placements the caller's role can read
post.description: backend-issues #02: whitelisted replacement for the raw /api/resource/Placement fallback. Enforces the doctype's own permissions (Manager, Admin, System Manager, Contract Parser, Ticketer, Finance Manager, Clearance Officer, Complaint Manager, Communication Manager, and the six country+step roles).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: JSON-encoded dict or list of Frappe filter conditions.

post.summary: List unpaid Wakala-bearing Embassy steps for the agency's own placements
Browse the candidate catalog
post.description: Standard-track, CV Generated, not yet locked by anyone, matching the agency's own destination country. Non-PII fields only.

post.summary: Select a candidate (creates a Placement)
post.description: Atomic, globally exclusive -- row-locked so two concurrent selections can't both succeed. free_replacement_for_complaint uses an approved free-replacement credit instead of billing normally.

post.summary: Manually match an unmatched statement line to a batch
post.description: Escape hatch for lines the automatic matcher couldn't confidently resolve.

post.summary: Upload a bank statement CSV
post.description: Parses rows and runs the automatic line-to-batch matcher (matches by total amount).

post.summary: Export commission records as a binary .xlsx (CSV fallback)
post.description: Streams the file directly in the response (frappe.response['filecontent']), not a JSON body.

post.summary: New/Unresolved (with age)/Resolved counts
Approved transaction totals grouped by destination country

by_country_birr.description: Keyed by destination_country, value in Birr.

post.summary: CVs created, medicals processed, clearances issued, embassies cleared, tickets booked, departures — for a date range
post.description: business-workflow-srs.md Part 8's exact list.

post.summary: Per-employee net expense + approval/rejection rate
Income/expense/commission/refund totals + outstanding/settled
post.description: Deliberately Admin-only, not Manager, unlike every other report here -- the financial-visibility wall from Step 8 applies to reporting too, not just the raw ledger.

post.summary: Recruitment funnel + SLA/turnaround dashboard data
post.description: Manager/Admin only. applicant_funnel/placement_funnel are current-state snapshot counts; conversion_rates and turnaround_days are computed from Process Event transitions within from_date/to_date; pending_overdue reuses get_placement_aging_report's thresholds plus unresolved-complaint and pending-transaction counts.

applicant_funnel.description: Current-state counts keyed by Applicant status: Draft, Registered, CV Generated, Cancelled.

placement_funnel.description: Current-state counts keyed by Placement status: Selected, Processing, Stamped, Ticketed, Departed, Cancelled.

post.summary: List every Pending Applicant Transaction, oldest-first
post.description: So nothing sits forgotten waiting on Finance review.

post.summary: Placements approaching the ticket deadline, and critical ones not yet Departed
post.description: Two buckets, both sorted worst-first (highest priority): approaching_ticket_deadline (25-29 days since contract_signed_date) and critical_not_departed (30+ days). Distinct from the contract_age_watchdog push notification -- this is a pull/list view.

post.summary: get_daily_work_report's same breakdown, per individual staff member
post.description: Grouped by whoever actually did the work (CV Record.generated_by, Clearance Step.completed_by, Process Event.actor for placement-stage transitions).

post.summary: App roles for a role-assignment picker
post.description: The roles this app actually uses (install.ROLES), filtered to those that exist as Role docs -- not Frappe's ~30 generic built-ins. Management-only, since assigning roles is an admin action.

post.summary: Assign / reassign a clearance step to an officer
post.description: Assigns a clearance step to an officer, creating the ToDo the officer acts through.

post.summary: List steps assigned to me (alias)
post.description: Alias of list_my_clearance_steps -- clearance steps currently assigned to the calling officer via their ToDos, with placement/applicant context.

post.summary: Render the Saudi Injaz application PDF (download)
post.description: Generate the Saudi Injaz application PDF for a Saudi clearance step (Saudi Arabia only). Open to any internal staff -- not just Taeshir -- so the Embassy desk and others can pull the paper; foreign agencies cannot. Built fresh from the step's latest Injaz attempt + Placement/Applicant, streamed as a download; nothing stored.

post.summary: Get an agency's default commission-rate table
post.description: The agency's configured default commission rates -- one row per destination country x entry track (Standard/Muayena) x gender (Male/Female). These are what commission accrual falls back to when a placement has no manual override.

post.summary: Replace an agency's default commission-rate table
post.description: Replaces the agency's default commission-rate table. Each row is {destination_country, entry_track, gender, rate, currency} -- set a per-male and per-female default for both the Standard and Muayena tracks (per destination country). entry_track must be Standard|Muayena, gender Male|Female, currency one of SAR/KWD/USD/ETB/AED/QAR (the operator chooses the commission currency per row). Returns the stored rows.

parameters.name: rates
parameters.description: List of rate rows (JSON). Each: {destination_country, entry_track, gender, rate, currency}

post.summary: Render an applicant's CV PDF (download)
post.description: Renders the CV PDF for a Standard-track applicant and streams it back as a download. If applicant_name is omitted, falls back to the first applicant in CV Generated status. Built fresh from the Applicant record, not stored.

post.summary: Pull live FX rates now (manual trigger)
post.description: Manually pulls live FX rates from the public source right now instead of waiting for the scheduled Global-mode fetch. Custom-mode sites never need this. Returns the currencies actually recorded (empty if the source was unreachable; existing cache stands).

post.summary: Record a partial/advance payment on a commission batch
post.description: Records a partial/advance payment received from a foreign agency against a commission batch when they remit less than the full requested total. Sets advance_amount (+ optional reference and received-on date); the controller recomputes balance_due_birr and flips an open batch to Partially Settled. Full settlement still goes through settle_batch / settle_batch_items.

post.summary: Hand-edit parsed contract/visa fields on a placement
post.description: Hand-edits the parsed contract/visa identifiers on a Placement -- primarily the visa number (the Injaz paper's left barcode) when parsing missed it or misread it. Only parsed-editable fields are accepted; status/applicant/contractor and other lifecycle fields are ignored, so this can neither move a placement's stage nor reassign it. Terminal placements are rejected.

post.summary: Get one placement (permission-scoped)
post.description: Fetches a single Placement's full record, enforcing the doctype's own read permission so callers only see placements they're entitled to. If placement_name is omitted, falls back to the first placement (tooling convenience).
x-roles: Any role with Placement read access

post.summary: Book/set the current Taeshir appointment
post.description: Book (or set details on) the current Taeshir appointment. Creates the Active Injaz attempt if none exists, else updates it. Rescheduling uses reschedule_taeshir_appointment; a missed one uses forfeit_injaz_and_restart.

post.summary: Reschedule the Taeshir appointment (no re-pay)
post.description: Move the current (Active) Taeshir appointment to a new date WITHOUT re-paying Injaz. The Injaz Application ID and any payment carry over; only the date changes.

post.summary: Record Injaz payment on the current attempt
post.description: Mark the current (Active) Injaz attempt Paid, recording amount / currency / receipt. Clears the taeshir_injaz_payment_reminder for this attempt.

post.summary: Forfeit missed Injaz and open a fresh attempt
post.description: The missed-appointment path: close the current attempt as Forfeited (fee lost) and open a fresh Active attempt with a new appointment date + (new) Injaz Application ID, unpaid. A written reason is required.

post.summary: Write off an agreed discount on a batch
post.description: Record an agreed discount on a commission batch (agency pays less by negotiation). Books an Expense Applicant Transaction for the shortfall and settles the batch once advance + write-off cover the total. Amounts in Birr. One write-off per batch.

post.summary: Release unpaid items back to the owed pool
post.description: Carry unpaid items out of a (usually settled) batch back to the owed pool for a new request. Each keeps a trace-back to its original batch; the old row becomes Released and drops out of that batch's total.

post.summary: List commission batches (money summary)
post.description: List commission batches with total, requested advance, advance received, write-off, balance due and settled_on. Optional contractor / status / destination_country filters.

post.summary: Get a batch with per-applicant items
post.description: Full batch detail including per-applicant item rows (item, applicant, amount_birr, status, carried-from batch) under items_detail -- the data behind the invoice PDF.

post.summary: Edit an existing agency's profile
post.description: Edit an agency's profile fields (contractor_name, country, communication_manager, batch_mode, batch_threshold). The login user and commission-rate table are managed elsewhere and ignored here. Changing contractor_name renames the record (it is the autoname).

post.summary: List all active chat threads for the current user
post.description: Lists all conversation threads (placement, corridor, complaint, or direct) accessible to the calling session user.

200.description: Array of active chat thread records

post.summary: List all complaints
post.description: Returns role-scoped list of complaint tickets (scoped to foreign agency tenant if called by Foreign Agency role).

post.summary: List newly opened complaints
post.description: Returns newly submitted complaints requiring triage or review.

post.summary: List agency employees with aggregated roles
post.description: Performs a single-query aggregation of agency employees, their system user accounts, enabled status, and operational roles.

200.description: List of employees with role details

post.summary: Create an agency employee and linked system user
post.description: Creates Frappe User, Employee record, and assigns designated operational roles atomically.

post.summary: Update operational roles assigned to an employee
post.description: Synchronizes Frappe Has Role assignments for the employee's system user account.

post.summary: Enable or disable an employee account
post.description: Toggles User.enabled and Employee.status between Active and Inactive.

post.summary: Reset an employee's system login password
post.description: Administrative password reset for agency staff users.

post.summary: Soft-delete or disable an employee
post.description: Marks the employee inactive and disables system login.

get.description: Unauthenticated probe for uptime monitors and load balancers. Returns 200 with service name, database status, and server time.

post.summary: Liveness and database readiness probe
post.description: Unauthenticated probe for uptime monitors and load balancers.

post.summary: Get Web Push VAPID public key
post.description: Returns the server VAPID public key for browser service worker push subscription.

post.summary: Regenerate Web Push VAPID keypair
post.description: Administrative regeneration of VAPID application server keys.

post.summary: Get non-PII catalog candidate detail for foreign agency
post.description: Returns rich profile (video, skills matrix, physical attributes, salary expectation) scoped to the foreign agency's destination country.

post.summary: List placements owned by the calling foreign agency
post.description: Returns reserved and active candidate placements belonging to the foreign agency session.

post.summary: Test S3/Wasabi/Local storage connectivity
post.description: Tests upload and download capability against the configured active storage provider.

post.summary: Get a candidate's photo (image)
post.description: Serve a portal candidate's photograph/photo_full_body as an image to an agency allowed to view that candidate (same gate as get_candidate_detail). Agencies can't read the private File docs directly; passport/contract/visa are never served here. Local file streamed, R2 object redirected. Also callable via GET to back an . Returns image bytes.
